name: image-hover-accordion
title: Image Hover Accordion
description: Five landscape photos sit side by side as narrow vertical strips; the strip under the pointer grows into a large picture and fades in a title and short description over a bottom gradient.
use: A portfolio or travel page needs a compact row of images that opens one at a time with its story.
avoid: The open panel is a hard 450 px wide, so the whole row does not shrink into a phone column.
a11y: Panels are plain divs that only respond to hover and click, so no keyboard path exists, and the images carry no alt text. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A row of five upright photo panels on a dark stage, one much wider than the other four. The open panel is a rounded landscape shot with a soft dark fade along its lower edge, where a white title and a smaller grey paragraph sit.
behaves: Moving the pointer onto any strip makes it expand to several times the width of the rest while the others stay as thin slivers. Its caption fades and lifts in shortly after the width settles; pressing on a strip gives a small shrink.
customise: There are no props: titles, descriptions, image links and tags live in the items array in the file, and the open width and timing are classes in the source.
weight: light: Five image panels with one width transition; nothing runs while the pointer is still.
demo: Mountain, snow and building photos titled Misty Mountain Peaks and Autumn Mountain Retreat.
issues: A white building photo is labelled Misty Mountain Majesty, so image and title disagree.
The row is fixed at roughly 650 px, so it overflows a narrow phone screen.
Captions fade out during a switch, leaving an open panel with no text for a moment.
polishWhy: Smooth widening and a clean caption gradient; white titles wash out on bright photos.
